extension.summary: Flashcards from a Google Sheet, hands-free
extension.description: Turns an idle TV into a flashcard loop: a question, then the answer, then the next card, from any public Google Sheet (column A question, column B answer, one deck per tab). Flashcard, multiple-choice and mixed modes, a timer bar before each reveal, day and night themes, slow drift and optional dimming for OLED screens, and an offline cache. Any key exits straight away. Uses the Sheetcards app's sheet and decks when the app is installed, or its own settings.
